aliaga.faqTitle: Renting a car in Aliağa: frequently asked questions

faq.q: Where do I pick up my car in Aliağa?
faq.a: You can collect your car from our office at Atatürk Mah. 356 Sk. No: 16/31, 35800 Aliağa/İzmir during office hours. To have it delivered to an address you choose, contact us.

faq.q: Can I rent a car for work at STAR Refinery, Petkim or the port area?
faq.a: Yes. Visitors travelling for business to these sites can collect their car from our Aliağa office with a reservation. For site work we also offer panel vans and double-cab vans alongside cars.

faq.q: Do you offer monthly car rental in Aliağa?
faq.a: Yes. Alongside short-term hire we offer monthly rental. Our prices exclude VAT; for a current monthly quote call 0507 350 31 35 or message us on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can you deliver a car from Aliağa to İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport?
faq.a: Yes. We offer vehicle delivery and meet-and-greet at the airport; just mention it when you book.

faq.q: Can I return the car somewhere other than Aliağa?
faq.a: Yes, one-way rental to a different location is possible. A one-way fee is added to the contract; contact us for details.

faq.q: What do I need to rent, and do you take a deposit?
faq.a: You must be at least 25 and have held a driving licence for at least 3 years. A valid driving licence, a Turkish ID card (passport for foreign nationals) and a credit card in the renter's name are enough. We don't take a deposit.
